description: Les zones de contraintes relatives à l'érosion côtière et aux mouvements de terrain (ZEMT) is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. La cartographie des zones de contraintes relatives à l’érosion côtière ainsi que la cartographie des zones de contraintes relatives à l'érosion côtière et aux mouvements de terrain (ZEMT) localisent les parties de territoire où doivent s’appliquer les normes relatives à l'érosion côtière et aux mouvements de terrain, prescrites par le gouvernement du Québec. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Its tags are Contrainte, Glissement de terrain, Mouvement de terrain, Zones de contraintes, Érosion côtière. It offers 19 resource(s) in GEOJSON, HTML, KML, LYRX, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
